verdict.rationale: Zep's Fern-rendered SDK Reference covers about 150 endpoints. Each page carries a "Try it" in-page API explorer with runnable requests and per-language code samples, and it is backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the explorer works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: each carry a "Try it" in-page API explorer alongside per-language code samples
